message.content:
This editorial illustration, set against a solid yellow background, features a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She has shoulder-length dark hair and wears a dark-colored cap with gold horizontal bands and a light-blue, short-sleeved button-down shirt with two breast pockets. Her left hand rests on her hip, while her right hand holds a white pole topped with a circular green sign. The sign features five yellow stars in a circular pattern, with one larger star on the left.

The word "TEMPO" is prominently displayed in large red letters at the top. Below it, the text "12-18 OKTOBER 2015" appears. To the right of the woman, large black text reads "SAYONARA SHINKANSEN." Smaller text below states: "Mengapa Menteri Rini M. Soemarno ngotot memilih konsorsium Cina dalam proyek kereta cepat Jakarta-Bandung." At the top, two smaller headlines read "PDIP DAN STRATEGI MEMBUNUH KPK" and "SELINGAN: BANJIR PENGUNGSI DI JERMAN." A barcode and the price "RP 39.500" are in the bottom right corner.
